verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Ollama works as a coding-agent backend. It is compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, so Claude Code can run on open models, and it supports a subset of the OpenAI API. The `ollama launch` command sets up and runs Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex with local or cloud models, with no config needed, and the GitHub README lists Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and OpenCode as supported integrations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on reports of a coding agent actually running against Ollama, and detail on the limits of the partial OpenAI API coverage.
